title: Sandcrawler
description: The silhouette of a Jawa sandcrawler on the horizon of a sand dune was unmistakable in the desert heat. It meant the scavenging Jawas were close by, sandcrawlers being their chosen conveyance due to the shelter they provided from the harsh climes of Tatooine. They were practical machines, able to roll over sand dunes as well as rockier terrain found on the planet. They were also equipped with things like magnetic suction tubes, which were able to load Droids and other salvaged bits of scrap into their cargo hold.
